SPACE CRAFT JOURNAL / CHOOSING A DESIGN PARTNER

Choosing a workplace design partner in Delhi.

Compare the process as carefully as the proposal. This Space Craft planning note looks at choosing a workplace design partner in delhi through the choices that affect everyday use, the details worth testing and the questions to take into your project brief.

Space Craft editorialPlanning note · 4 min read
IN THIS NOTEBring the same brief to each conversationAsk for relevant evidenceMake the commercial assumptions visibleTranslate values into behavioursBefore you decide
01 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Bring the same brief to each conversation

Share the measured area, building condition, intended occupancy, budget assumptions and desired scope. Different inputs make proposals difficult to compare.

02 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Ask for relevant evidence

Discuss directly relevant project examples, the people involved and the proposed deliverables. Confirm who will be responsible for design, pricing, site coordination and changes.

03 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Make the commercial assumptions visible

Ask about inclusions, exclusions, review stages and how changes are agreed. A well-presented image should sit alongside a clear description of what will actually be provided.

04 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Translate values into behaviours

Ask what the business wants people to experience: clarity, openness, craft, energy or calm. Connect these words to planning and material decisions rather than applying them only as slogans.

BEFORE YOU DECIDE

Take this into your brief.

  • Compare equivalent scopes and deliverables.
  • Verify references directly where appropriate.
  • Confirm responsibilities and change procedures before appointing anyone.

Write down one priority, one constraint and one question you still need to answer. Review them beside the plan or material sample before agreeing the next design decision.

General design considerations for discussion. Product suitability, technical performance, statutory requirements and project pricing need appropriate, project-specific review. Images are illustrative.
